entries.name: AnythingLLM
entries.use_for: Self-hosted RAG workspace with built-in vector DB, agents and a developer API
entries.why: MIT all-in-one RAG platform: document ingestion, many vector DB and LLM backends, plus an API and embeddable chat widget.

entries.name: Chroma
entries.use_for: Store and query embeddings locally or as a server, with a few lines of Python or JS.
entries.why: Simplest way to get a vector store running: embedded mode for prototypes, client/server for production; default store in many RAG tutorials.

entries.name: cognee
entries.use_for: Turn documents and data into a queryable knowledge graph memory for agents
entries.why: Combines vector search and graph extraction (ECL pipelines) to give agents structured long-term memory; self-hostable.

entries.name: Docling
entries.use_for: Convert PDFs, DOCX, PPTX and HTML into clean Markdown/JSON for RAG ingestion
entries.why: IBM-originated LF AI project; accurate layout, table and reading-order extraction, the hard part of RAG ingestion.

entries.name: Faiss
entries.use_for: In-process similarity search and clustering of dense vectors, CPU or GPU
entries.why: The reference ANN library from Meta; powers many vector DBs and is the default for local, embedded vector indexes.

entries.name: FastEmbed
entries.use_for: Generate dense and sparse embeddings locally on CPU without PyTorch.
entries.why: ONNX-based and small, so it fits serverless and CI; supports popular open embedding and SPLADE models.

entries.name: FlagEmbedding (BGE)
entries.use_for: Use and fine-tune BGE embedding and reranker models for retrieval.
entries.why: Home of the BGE models that rank near the top of MTEB; includes training and reranking tooling.

entries.name: GraphRAG
entries.use_for: Build a knowledge graph from documents with an LLM and answer global questions over it.
entries.why: Microsoft Research reference implementation of graph-based RAG; strong for whole-corpus questions plain vector search misses.

entries.name: Haystack
entries.use_for: Build production RAG and search pipelines with pluggable retrievers, rankers and LLMs
entries.why: Mature, modular RAG framework (since 2019) with explicit pipelines and integrations for every major vector store.

entries.name: hnswlib
entries.use_for: Header-only HNSW index for fast approximate nearest-neighbour search
entries.why: Canonical HNSW implementation by the algorithm author; used inside Chroma and many other systems.

entries.name: LanceDB
entries.use_for: Embed a serverless vector store in your app, backed by files on disk or object storage.
entries.why: No server to run; columnar Lance format handles multimodal data and scales from laptop to S3.

entries.name: LEANN
entries.use_for: Storage-efficient vector index for local RAG on laptops
entries.why: MLSys best paper: recomputes embeddings on the fly to cut index storage about 97%, making personal-scale RAG cheap.

entries.name: LightRAG
entries.use_for: Add knowledge-graph-based retrieval to a RAG system with incremental updates.
entries.why: Simpler and cheaper graph RAG than heavier alternatives, with a server, web UI and multiple storage backends.

entries.name: LlamaIndex
entries.use_for: Build RAG pipelines: ingest documents, index them and query them with an LLM.
entries.why: The most widely used RAG-focused framework, with hundreds of loaders, vector store integrations and 2,000+ contributors.

entries.name: Mem0
entries.use_for: Persistent long-term memory layer for AI agents and assistants
entries.why: Most adopted agent memory layer: extracts, stores and retrieves user facts across sessions on top of vector and graph stores.

entries.name: Milvus
entries.use_for: Run a distributed vector database for billion-scale similarity search.
entries.why: Built for very large collections with GPU indexes and horizontal scaling; Milvus Lite covers local development.

entries.name: OpenViking
entries.use_for: Context database unifying agent memory, knowledge RAG and skills
entries.why: ByteDance Volcengine project that organises agent context as a filesystem-like hierarchy with tiered retrieval; AGPL-3.0.

entries.name: PaddleOCR
entries.use_for: OCR and document parsing to turn PDFs and images into structured data for RAG
entries.why: Mature multilingual OCR + layout/table parsing (PP-Structure) that feeds clean text into retrieval pipelines; Apache-2.0.

entries.name: PageIndex
entries.use_for: Vectorless, reasoning-based RAG over long documents via a tree index
entries.why: Builds a table-of-contents style tree and lets the LLM navigate it, a strong alternative to chunk+embed for long structured docs.

entries.name: pgvector
entries.use_for: Add vector similarity search to an existing Postgres database.
entries.why: Keeps vectors next to your relational data with HNSW/IVFFlat indexes; supported by nearly every managed Postgres provider.

entries.name: PrivateGPT
entries.use_for: Private RAG API layer over local models for document Q&A
entries.why: OpenAI-style API with ingestion, retrieval and chat over local models, a ready backend for private document assistants.

entries.name: Qdrant
entries.use_for: Run a dedicated vector database with payload filtering for semantic and hybrid search.
entries.why: Fast Rust engine with strong metadata filtering, quantization and simple REST/gRPC APIs; easy to self-host or use as cloud.

entries.name: RAG-Anything
entries.use_for: All-in-one multimodal RAG over PDFs, images, tables and equations
entries.why: From the LightRAG team: parses mixed-content documents and builds a multimodal knowledge graph for retrieval in one pipeline.

entries.name: RAGFlow
entries.use_for: Self-hosted RAG engine with deep document understanding and citation-grounded answers
entries.why: Most-starred open RAG engine; strong layout-aware parsing of PDFs/tables, deployable via Docker with an API.

entries.name: Sentence Transformers
entries.use_for: Compute text embeddings and rerank results with pretrained or fine-tuned models.
entries.why: The standard Python library for embedding and cross-encoder models, with thousands of compatible models on Hugging Face.

entries.name: sqlite-vec
entries.use_for: Add vector search to SQLite with a tiny, dependency-free extension
entries.why: Runs anywhere SQLite runs (incl. WASM, mobile); successor to sqlite-vss and the go-to for local-first vector search.

entries.name: turbovec
entries.use_for: Compressed vector index using TurboQuant quantization
entries.why: Rust ANN index with Python bindings built on TurboQuant, giving high recall at a fraction of FAISS-style memory.

entries.name: txtai
entries.use_for: All-in-one embeddings database for semantic search, RAG and LLM workflows
entries.why: Single package combining vector index, SQL, graph and pipelines; lightweight alternative to running a separate vector DB.

entries.name: Unstructured
entries.use_for: Partition and chunk messy documents (PDF, HTML, email, Office) into elements for LLMs
entries.why: Widely used ingestion layer with partitioning and chunking strategies; integrated into LangChain and LlamaIndex.

entries.name: Weaviate
entries.use_for: Run a vector database that stores objects plus vectors with built-in hybrid search and vectorizer modules.
entries.why: Combines BM25 and vector search out of the box and can call embedding models for you; mature clients for Python, TS, Go and Java.

entries.name: WeKnora
entries.use_for: Document understanding and RAG framework for building knowledge-base Q&A
entries.why: Tencent RAG stack: multimodal parsing, hybrid retrieval and agentic reasoning, deployable as a service with a web UI.

license_verified.note: LICENSE states WeKnora is licensed under MIT; bundled third-party components keep their own licenses

entries.name: zvec
entries.use_for: Lightweight in-process vector database embedded in your app
entries.why: Alibaba-built embedded vector DB: SQLite-style, no server to run, fast ANN search for local and edge RAG.
